quests.title: Home Lies Over the Ocean

dialogue.t: How many dishes should we make for lunch tomorrow?
Our kids can eat a lot these days. Let's just cook more.
Hmm? Who might you be...

dialogue.sit: May I ask if this is Atsuko's house?
Would you happen to be Atsuko's parents?

dialogue.t: Yes, we are. What can I do for you?

dialogue.sit: Atsuko asked me to bring you this letter.

dialogue.t: Letter? Why would that child suddenly want to write a letter to us?
The letter is quite long... I mean, she's back at home already, so if she wants to say something, she should just say it to us directly.
...Traveler, it sounds like you're surprised? It's true that Atsuko was traveling abroad before, but she's come back now.
Why does she want to send a letter to us when she's already back home with us? Did you mistake us for someone else?
Wait a minute, dear. I had a brief scan of the letter. The handwriting and the way it's written, it's definitely from our daughter.
The letter also says that she doesn't plan to come back in the near future, and tells us to take care of ourselves.
What does this all mean? Could it be that she came back on her own while getting this Traveler to deliver this letter to us?
I feel there might be a misunderstanding. After that child comes home, we'll ask her.
Unfortunately, Atsuko had matters to attend to today. After she's back, we'll ask her for clarification.
If it's okay with you, please find us tomorrow evening. We'll get that child to explain everything to you.
That child said she's busy working. After breakfast, she left the house in a hurry.
Yeah, every day, she leaves early and comes back late. We only get to see her in the evening, so we aren't sure what she's really up to.
Anyway, please come over tomorrow evening. If that child has done something wrong, we'll make sure she apologizes to you in person.
We're really sorry that you had to travel such a long way.
That Atsuko, if only she was more well behaved...
I wonder how mom is doing, and dad as well...
Why is our daughter back before the date of signature on this letter?
Let's not overthink things. It's probably a misunderstanding. It'll be more helpful if you can help me figure out what to make for lunch tomorrow.
Atsuko hasn't returned yet. Please come back in the evening.
If you wait until the evening, then Atsuko should be back.
Atsuko should be back now. Let's knock on the door.

dialogue.sit: They seem to be talking about something.

dialogue.t: That being said, I wonder what happened to the Tanuki that we rescued before.
You're too kind. That Tanuki only had a minor scrape on its leg. If you let it be in the bushes, it would've recovered by itself.
I couldn't help it. It was looking at me with tears in its eyes. It looked very pitiful. My conscience just wouldn't let me.
Forget it. It's never wrong to do good deeds. It's just that it ate a bit too much, nearly as much as me...
Who is it?

dialogue.sit: I'm the Traveler that came here before.

dialogue.t: Ahh, I remember you. Please wait here.
He—Hello! I'm Atsuko, first... no... nice to see you again!
Sorry, I was homesick. After I gave you the letter, I changed my mind and took a ship back to Inazuma.
Ahaha... Sorry for not clarifying things before, and making you travel so far.

dialogue.sit: How did you return to Inazuma?

dialogue.t: ...Ah, I had my ways, haha. You don't have to worry about that.
Um, I've prepared the payment for you. Please take it. Thanks for your help. Hurry... uh, hurry up and go about the rest of your day.
How come the things that Atsuko are telling us now are different from what it was before? If returning to Inazuma was so easy, why did you ask us for help in the first place?

dialogue.sit: What happened to your business in Liyue?

dialogue.t: Business? What business? I had a business in Liyue!?
...Ah, that kind of stuff is unimportant. Nothing is more important than family. I already entrusted it all to someone else, ah... haha.
Hang on! The real Atsuko had trouble finding a job in Liyue, there's no way that she'd suddenly become rich!
I—I'm Atsuko, of course! I look like Atsuko and sound like Atsuko. What's there to be suspicious about?
Look here! Stop being so persistent... forget it. I won't talk to you anymore. I've got work tomorrow. I'm heading off now.
Atsuko! That child... Why did she get angry all of a sudden...
Sorry about that, Traveler. That child must be too tired from her work.
But you saw her for yourselves. That's our daughter. That letter... Maybe that child forgot about it.
But in any case, we'd still like to thank you for the trouble you went through. As for the payment... Would you be able to wait a little longer?
Nothing of that sort. We can still afford the payment.
You know how we told you that Atsuko goes to work during the day? The payment that she receives has always been strange.
She always brings back weird seeds or some wild fruits, but she never brings back Mora.
Even though things like that do have some value, we have to sell them first.
For a traveler like you, I guess Mora would be more convenient.
Please come here again tomorrow. By then, we should be able to give you the Mora.
Where did our daughter run off to...

dialogue.sit: Has Atsuko gone off to work again?

dialogue.t: Even if she's working the next day, Atsuko usually says something to us before leaving. But today, she left without saying anything.
After you left yesterday, Atsuko said she was tired and went straight to her room to sleep.
By the time we got up the next day, she wasn't in bed anymore.
We tried looking everywhere for her. My husband searched far and wide.
However, even after half a day, we still couldn't find any traces of our daughter.
*sigh* Did that child go off on another journey again? What a troublesome child...
Calm down, dear. I'll look for her again. Please sweep Atsuko's room first.
After that child left, she didn't close the window properly. A lot of leaves blew into the room.
Before I forget. Here's the payment. Please take it.
*sigh* That child, Atsuko... Where is she off to this time...

quests.description: Atsuko, who is living in Liyue, seems to have something on her mind…
